problem.statement_latex: In the Childs--Schulman--Vazirani shifted-subset model over $\mathbb F_q^d$, with $q$ odd and $d$ odd, the hidden set is the sphere $\{x:\sum_i x_i^2=r\}$. Determine the quadratic character $\chi(r)$ from the randomized hiding oracle.
problem.statement_text: In the Childs–Schulman–Vazirani shifted-subset model over $\mathbb F_q^d$, with $q$ odd and $d$ odd, the hidden set is the sphere $\{x:\sum_i x_i^2=r\}$. Determine the quadratic character $\chi(r)$ from the randomized hiding oracle.
